metas.name: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
metas.description: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

metas.name: Minnal Murali
metas.description: A tailor gains special powers after being struck by lightning but must take down an unexpected foe if he is to become the superhero his hometown in Kerala needs.

metas.name: Aadu 3 Part 1
metas.description: Shaji Pappan and Co. opens a Pandora's box of reincarnations and multiple timelines  leading to comic chaos of epic proportions.

metas.name: Odiyan
metas.description: With the arrival of electricity in the region under the British rule, the Odiyan clan that possesses the supernatural powers to assume animal form find it difficult to survive as they are ruthlessly captured and killed by the British. How the last Odiyan tries to save his clan with his stealth attacks, forms the crux.

metas.name: Vadakkan
metas.description: A paranormal investigator based in Helsinki ventures to Kerala to probe a series of mysterious deaths during a reality TV show shoot and confronts an unspeakable entity from a Dravidian cult practice, lurking on a mysterious island.

metas.name: My Dear Kuttichathan
metas.description: The story revolves around a mystical indigenous goblin called "Kuttichathan" who is under the spell of an evil sorcerer; however, it gets released by three children and then befriends them.

metas.name: Rock
metas.description: Rock follows the mysterious disappearance of a senior geologist from India's Antarctic mission during the COVID pandemic. As authorities scramble to trace her, she slips beyond their reach. Drifting through shifting realms, her journey intertwines with ancient lore of the Earth's origins, dissolving the boundaries between science and myth, presence and eternity.

metas.name: Sumathy Valav
metas.description: Sumathy Valav is a 2022 Indian Malayalam-language dark fantasy film based on the mystery road in Trivandrum . The film was directed by Bernard Joseph . The story concerns ghosts, spirits, and black magic. The film stars Vishnu Narayanan , Gautham K Biju , Vishal , Christy , Sreeraj and Jack .  The film was inspired by some true invents of a mysterious road in Trivandrum , Kerala . The DOP of the film is Ajay Raju .  The music and background score of the film  is done by Abin Ponnachan and the sound design is done by Vidhu Nandan .

metas.name: It's a Medical Miracle
metas.description: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

metas.name: Incident
metas.description: A police inspector gets stuck deep inside a forest with a wounded leg but later realizes that he's part of a much bigger conspiracy.

metas.name: Sreekrishna Parunthu
metas.description: Kumaran Thampi, a wizard, is not able to keep his vow of celibacy. This keeps getting him into many troubles, most of which are lethal.

metas.name: Sukhamano Sukhamann
metas.description: Theo, an ambulance driver stigmatized by his town, begins seeing visions of deceased people he transports. His troubled mind, shaped by childhood loss, creates these apparitions as emotional substitutes for connection.

metas.name: Kummatty
metas.description: A stranger who may be the trickster magician Kummatty comes to a village in Malabar, India.

metas.name: Yoddha
metas.description: Fate brings a young man from rural Kerala to be the protector of a young Lama in Nepal, who is being chased by a dangerous cult.

metas.name: DAYDREAMS
metas.description: Two specimens are sent to earth for a day as part of an experiment. Both are warned not to consume the 'forbidden fruit'. Their every move is being watched and observed.

metas.name: Iblis
metas.description: Vaisakhan is nothing less than smitten by Fida, and all he can think of is how to make her his own. The only person who can help him in this endeavour is his bohemian grandfather.

metas.name: Allauddinum Albhutha Vilakkum
metas.description: A rendering of the classic Arabian tale of Aladdin and his magic lamp.

metas.name: Shankaranum Mohananum
metas.description: A photographer is haunted by the ghost of his dead brother who always craved love. Mohan is a photographer who has separated from his wife, an aspiring actress. His brother, Sankaran is married to a much younger Rajalakshmi, whom he deeply loves. Sankaran dies due to a snakebite, but returns as a ghost. He then begins haunting his own brother!

metas.name: Vellinakshatram
metas.description: Vinod loves Aswathi, who belongs to a royal family with dark secrets. However, strange events occur after Aswathi mysteriously dies during childbirth and their daughter is believed to be possessed.

metas.name: Guru
metas.description: A few political goons, disguised as Muslims, cause trouble at the temple and kill Raghuraman's family. Later, Raghuraman joins an extremist group and decides to avenge his family's death.

metas.name: Aayushkalam
metas.description: Balakrishnan who is sick and has a heart disease, gets a heart transplant from a man who died in a recent car accident. The operation is a success but, Balakrishnan starts seeing the ghost of Aby, who lingers around for Balakrishnan to help him find his murderer so that his soul can rest in peace.

metas.name: Daivame Kaithozham K.Kumar Akanam
metas.description: Krishna Kumar, an idler, swaps roles with his hardworking wife as a challenge, in the presence of God. However, their lives turn upside down as God refuses to let them go back to their normal routine.

metas.name: Anandabhadram
metas.description: To honour his mother's final wish, Ananthan returns to his ancestral village from America and attempts to light a lamp at the family temple. However, his quest is thwarted by an evil magician named Digambaran who seeks to harness the temple's hidden powers.

metas.name: Malaikottai Vaaliban
metas.description: Malaikottai Vaaliban, an uncontested warrior proves himself to be a reigning hero across time and geographies, defeating every opponent he encounters. As Vaaliban continues his victorious journey along with his aids Chinnappaiyyan & Ayyanar meets Rangapattinam Rangarani, an ethereal dancer at a betting parlour in Nooraanathalayur. This is the moment that also invites Chamathakan, a villainous presence who will shadow Vaaliban through the rest of his journey. This group then proceed on journey with many twists and turns that leads Vaaliban to his ultimate challenge.

metas.name: Esthappan
metas.description: Esthappan is a fisherman, who lives in a seashore colony. His story unfolds through narrations by other fishermen about his miraculous acts. Through the contradictory statements of these people, a mystical figure of Esthappan unfolds.

metas.name: Njan Gandharvan
metas.description: The film is an esoteric fantasy about a girl and her passion for a celestial lover, who keeps appearing from a wooden statue that she found on a beach but is invisible to others.

metas.name: Athbhutha Dweepu
metas.description: Six navy officers are washed up on a mysterious island when their helicopter crashes into the sea. Their lives are at risk when they find the men on the island are dwarves, who consider the officers to be monsters.

metas.name: Nanpakal Nerathu Mayakkam
metas.description: A group of Malayali travellers, returning to Kerala by bus after their visit to Velankanni, all doze off in a lazy nap after lunch. One of the travelers, James, stops the bus in a village in Tamil Nadu. He starts behaving like a native of the place and speaking in Tamil, confusing his fellow passengers and the villagers alike. He walks amidst faith, delusion, dream and trance, followed by others.

metas.name: Daya
metas.description: The film is set in the Middle-East in the pre-Islam period. It is about the adventures and exploits of a lively and intelligent slave girl named Daya (Manju Warrier). Mansoor (Krishna), the son of an aging and wealthy nobleman, is used to an extravagant way of life.
